properties.name: spring.ai.vectorstore.pgvector.initialize-schema
properties.description: Whether to auto-create the vector store table on startup.

properties.name: spring.ai.vectorstore.pgvector.index-type
properties.description: Index type for vector search. Supported: HNSW, IVFFlat.

properties.name: spring.ai.vectorstore.pgvector.dimensions
properties.description: Vector dimensions of the embedding model.

properties.name: spring.ai.vectorstore.pgvector.distance-type
properties.description: Distance function for similarity search. Supported: COSINE_DISTANCE, EUCLIDEAN_DISTANCE, NEGATIVE_INNER_PRODUCT.

properties.name: spring.ai.vectorstore.pgvector.max-document-batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of documents to insert per batch.

properties.name: spring.ai.vectorstore.pgvector.schema-name
properties.description: PostgreSQL schema name for the vector store table.

properties.name: app.datasource.postgresql.driver-class-name
properties.description: JDBC driver class for the PostgreSQL datasource.

properties.name: app.datasource.postgresql.jdbc-url
properties.description: JDBC URL for the PostgreSQL datasource used by pgvector.
